reconstruction: For t<=1/200 the Pauli-Parseval bounds give ||V_H||_F<23/200 and ||W_H-W0||_F<23/200. The off-block part of W0 is exactly the <=2-excitation compression of its transverse local field, so its operator norm is <=4, while ||W0||<=8.

All between-block gaps of D are at least 2; divided-gap anti-Hermitian S1 therefore has ||S1||_F<=23/400. With B=[V,S1]+1/2[[D,S1],S1], ||B||_F<=2(23/200)(23/400)+2*5*(23/400)^2=3703/80000<47/1000. Thus ||Qcal||<41/5 and ||off Qcal||<21/5.

The exact normalized state has H=D+hV+eta^2 W, h=eta sqrt(1-eta^2). The first unitary expansion is D+hV_diag+eta^2(W+B)-eta^4 B+R; this keeps normalization exactly and does not discard the eta^4 correction.

For eta<=9/40, exp(2 eta*23/400)<103/100; the three D/V/W Taylor-tail bounds sum to 580473701/600000000 times eta^3, less than eta^3. The block approximant perturbation from D is at most 441/1000, so both needed block gaps exceed 2-2*(441/1000)=559/500>11/10.

Cauchy interlacing lambda2(H*)<=lambda1(compression_without_weight0) and lambda3(H*)<=lambda2(that compression) permits two exact block upper estimates. The two off-block norms are each <=eta^2*(21/5); the first contributes one copy and the second two copies of the squared/gap bound.

After a rank-three Weyl remainder, the normalized error coefficient is 54870831/17600000<13/4. Subject to the separately audited/review-pending Hessian coefficient bound -15/4, this leaves -1/2 eta^2 in H and the original gap t eta^2/32. The far-case union bound supplies delta>=81/800>1/10>=20t for eta>=9/40 and t<=1/200.
